milestones.goal: Create a genuine Level-1 Rogue through the ordinary creation menu; One of the two starter skills MUST be rogue.fan_of_blades; choose the other freely. Use AoE only when tactically useful; do not force fights or ignore friendly fire..
Develop your freely chosen Level-1 character through real play until the Engine confirms Level 15. Keep improving gear and skills; then continue to class evolution instead of stopping.

milestones.name: Bloodhound Rogue
milestones.goal: After Level 15, finish pending danger, inspect #class/#feats and freely choose an offered E class. Panels are read-only; if the offer is due, take a safe ordinary story turn. Normal is valid: never farm Rare. Only Engine-confirmed acceptance finishes this milestone; no E fight is required.

turns.input: I choose Rogue.
I select Fan of Blades and Piercing Thrust as my two skills.
I walk toward the city gates of Alderwatch and head for the Adventurers' Guild to look for a suitable novice contract.
I ask the clerk to register me with the Guild and pay the two silver fee.
I tell the clerk I'll take the Millpond Wolf contract and ask her to sign it out to me.
I take the slip and head out of the Guild, following the towpath downriver toward Marrow & Sons Gristmill.
turns.placeName: the millpond and sluice of Marrow & Sons Gristmill

turns.input: I move quietly along the reed line toward the far end of the pond, watching for the wolf.
turns.placeName: the far end of the millpond along the reed line

turns.input: I open with Fan of Blades at the wolf from twenty paces, then close in with my dagger drawn.
turns.placeName: the far end of the millpond along the reed line

turns.input: I head back along the towpath to the Adventurers' Guild in Alderwatch and turn in the completed Millpond Wolf contract for the reward.
#assign AGI 2 PER 2 WIL 1
I ask the clerk if the Guild buys wolf pelts and fangs, and if so, what he'll offer for one pelt and three fangs.
"Log them, twelve copper suits me fine." I hand over the pelt and three fangs.
"Done — the pelt and three fangs for twelve copper, as you logged it." I hand the goods over and take the coins.
I walk to the Guild contract board and look over the fresh postings.
I take the Bramble Fen Adders contract slip and ask the clerk to accept it as my active contract.
I leave the Guild and follow the drainage road south and east toward the reed-cutters' path in Alderwatch Fen, watching the ground for adders as I go.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I move carefully along the corduroy path, checking the near hummocks for adders.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I throw a Fan of Blades at the two adders on the hummock.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I finish Fen Adder A with a Piercing Thrust.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I finish Fen Adder B with a Piercing Thrust.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I spend my free stat points: #assign VIT 4 WIL 3 STR 3
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I press on along the corduroy path, checking the next hummocks for adders.
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I back off a few strides along the corduroy log, then throw a Fan of Blades at the den mouth where the hiss comes from.
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I step closer and prod the hissing den mouth with my dagger to draw the adder out.
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I strike the coiled adder with a Piercing Thrust, then immediately step back toward the log to keep my distance.
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I finish the wounded adder with a Basic Attack.
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I spend my free stat points: #assign VIT 5 WIL 5 STR 5
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: #status
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: #assign VIT 5 WIL 5 STR 5
turns.placeName: adder den under the rotted stump

turns.input: I leave the den mound alone and follow the corduroy path back toward town to recover and sell my adder loot before hunting the last two.
I head to the market row and ask the hides buyer what he'll pay for my three adder skins, four fangs and two venom sacs.
I take the seventeen copper in trade: sell the lot and ask for a salve and bandaging for my arm.
I accept the 16 copper bid and ask for the salve and bandaging.
I take the five-copper deal: salve, bandaging, and the second pot.

I place five copper on the counter and buy the fen salve, the bandaging roll and the second pot of salve for five copper, then wash my arm at the trough and pack the salve into the punctures before wrapping it.
I buy the second pot of fen salve for one copper, then wrap my arm with the bandaging roll.
I ask a smith on the market row what he'd charge for a better dagger and a suit of light armor.
I'll take the common jerkin for 48 copper and have it fitted — that's what I can afford alongside my other gear.
I equip the new common jerkin in place of the starter light armor.
I leave the smithy and head back to the Bramble Fen to hunt the last two adders for my contract.
I walk east out of Alderwatch along the fen road, taking the corduroy path into the Bramble Fen to hunt the last two adders.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I strike the sunning adder with Piercing Thrust, then back toward the fork to keep the reeds in view.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I back away down the path away from both the adder and the still reeds, and head back to Alderwatch to rest — I'm too badly wounded to fight two snakes.
I go to the inn and ask for a room for the night, then sleep until morning.
I accept the innkeeper's offer: the room for the night plus supper and porridge at first light, six copper total.
I'll take the soup and bread for three copper, and the porridge at first light for two — six copper for the food in total.
I eat the soup and bread, then go up to my room and sleep until morning.
I pay the two copper and eat the porridge, then head to the Guild hall to check the contract board.
I ask the clerk to turn in my adder contract — I've defeated three of the five adders so far.
I take the slip back and head to the Bramble Fen to hunt the last two adders.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I circle the hummock quietly and search the thorn tangle for the adder, dagger ready.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I lunge at the adder's head with Piercing Thrust.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I step forward to close the distance, then strike at the adder's head with Piercing Thrust.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I search the reed banks and mud along the corduroy path for the fifth and last adder, dagger ready.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I circle back to the bramble hummocks and search them for the fifth adder, dagger ready.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I wade out along the water's edge where the mud is softest and search the shallows for the fifth adder.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I strike at the adder's head with Piercing Thrust before it can slip deeper into the water.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I wade through the shallow mud to close the distance, then strike at the adder's head with Piercing Thrust.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: #assign AGI 3 PER 2
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I head back along the corduroy path to the Guild hall in town and turn in the completed adder contract.
I'll take the Primer of Guard for 80 copper.
I read the Primer of Guard with my dagger in hand to learn the guard skill.
I read the Primer of Guard with my dagger in hand for 2 hours to learn the guard skill.
I head to the tanner's shop and ask to broker the fen adder skins and wolf pelt as arranged.
I'll take the twelve silver outright for the lot.
I sell the two fen adder skins and the wolf pelt to the tanner outright for twelve silver total.
#bag
I sell the two fen adder skins to the tanner outright for twelve silver total, as she offered.
Two and a half silver for that one skin, then. I accept your offer and hand over the skin.
I hand over the adder skin on the counter and take the two and a half silver for it.
Two silver it is — I take the coins and hand over the skin.
I still have one more fen adder skin — I offer it to her at the same two silver.
I head to the smithy up the row to check light weapons and armour against my skills and coin.
I ask the smith to show me the light armor in the back yard, and mention I'm also eyeing the fine dagger on the rack.
I'll take the common dagger for 80 copper — I hand over the coins and take it.
I buy the common F-Rank dagger from Smith B for 80 copper total — I hand over the coins and take the dagger.
I want to buy the common F-Rank dagger from Smith B for a total price of 80 copper. I pay 80 copper and take the dagger.
I equip the new common F-Rank dagger and ask the smith if he'll buy my retired starter dagger off me.
I accept — ten copper for the starter dagger, deal.
Before I go — do you buy fen adder fangs? I've got a few spare from the fens.
I head to the apothecary on Cordwainer Lane and ask Wren if she'll buy my four fen adder fangs.
I lay the four fen adder fangs out on her counter for inspection.
I'll take the five copper for the lot — deal.
The sound ones I'll keep for Marta's return — but I'll sell you the cracked fang for the copper, if you'll take it now.
I pocket all four fangs to carry myself, thank Wren, and head to the tanner to broker the adder skin as arranged.
I unroll the adder skin and show it to her. What will you give me for it — and I've a wolf pelt to sell too, if you take those.
I'll take the six copper for the adder skin — and I pull out the wolf pelt and hand it over for her to inspect.
I'll take the twenty copper for the wolf pelt — deal.
I step back from the counter. "My mistake — the pelt's not mine to sell either. Keep it, I'll not press a bad trade." I thank her and leave the shop.
#assign AGI 3 PER 2
I head from the tanner's row to find an inn with a room for the night.

"Done — if the wolf's dead by my hand and your niece safe, I'll call at the Bellfounder for that silver." I shake on it if he will, then cross the square to the Sluice & Cask and ask the innkeep the price of a room and a meal for the night.
"Staying. Room for the night and the hot stew — that's twelve copper." I pay her.
"The stew at four copper, then — I'll take it now." I pay her and eat before heading out.
I head east to the Bellfounder smithy and ask the smith to see his light weapons and light armour.
"What's the price on the common light armor and the gambeson? I've the coin for a fair upgrade on either."

"Forty-eight copper for the leather — that's beyond my forty-four, so no sale today." I thank the smith and look around the yard for Harl Ottoway, who said he'd be at the Bellfounder this morning about the sluice wolf.
"Still willing — one silver, paid when the wolf's dead and your niece is safe. I'll head to the sluice now."
I draw my dagger and aim a Piercing Thrust at the wolf's throat.
I strike with Piercing Thrust at the wolf.
I close the distance to the wolf and thrust with Piercing Thrust as soon as I'm in reach.
I brace and drive Piercing Thrust up into the wolf as it lands on me.
I step into SHORT range and loose Fan of Blades at the wolf.
I skin the proof of the kill, take the pelt and fangs, and head back to Harl Ottoway at the mill to tell him the sluice wolf is dead and claim the one silver he promised.
turns.placeName: the millpond and sluice of Marrow & Sons Gristmill

turns.input: I thank Harl and head to the tanner down the lane to ask his price for the wolf pelt.
turns.placeName: the tanner's yard down the lane behind the mill

turns.input: I accept the four copper and hand over the pelt, then ask if he knows a smith or trader in Valedorn Crown who sells light weapons and armour.
turns.placeName: the tanner's yard down the lane behind the mill

turns.input: I head to Cordery's on Buckle Street and tell old Cordery that Bramm the tanner sent me, then ask to see his light daggers and armour.
I ask Cordery the prices on the fine dagger, the oiled common leathers, and the fine boiled-leather light armor, and whether he'd take my old jerkin and starter armor in trade.
I take off the old jerkin and my starter light armor and hand both to Cordery, asking what he'd knock off the fine light armor's price for the pair.
I shake my head and take back my old jerkin and starter armor. "Nineteen silver is beyond my purse today, Cordery — I'll keep my old kit for now. Thanks for the straight look."
I thank Cordery and head to the Adventurers' Guild hall to look over the contract board for a job I can take at my level.
I take the Fen Adders contract slip from the Novice board and bring it to the clerk to accept it.
I head out of Alderwatch toward the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path in Alderwatch Fen to hunt fen adders.
turns.placeName: the bramble hummocks along the reed-cutters' corduroy path, Alderwatch Fen

turns.input: I thank the reed-cutters and move toward the east brambles where the big adder went down, keeping low and watching the reeds for movement.

turns.input: I close the distance slowly through the thin reeds, then strike with Piercing Thrust at the adder's exposed back before it can lift its head.
turns.placeName: east brambles where the big adder went down

turns.input: I close the remaining distance to reach ENGAGED range, then strike the adder with Piercing Thrust before it can lift its head.

turns.input: I strike the adder's head with Piercing Thrust while it waits at the water's edge.

turns.input: I push the last step through the mud to reach ENGAGED range with the adder's head, then strike with Piercing Thrust.

turns.input: I circle quietly around the hummock's flank to ambush the adder, then strike its head with Piercing Thrust.

turns.input: I strike the adder's head with Piercing Thrust from ambush.
